facts.fact: J.D. Power forecasted that the pandemic will accelerate online car buying, which will account for 25% of retail sales by 2025.
facts.quote: J.D. Power has forecasted that the pandemic will accelerate online car buying, which will account for 25% of retail sales by 2025.

facts.fact: About 43% of car buyers are willing to complete their entire purchase process online, according to J.D. Power.
facts.quote: of car buyers are willing to complete their entire purchase process online.

facts.fact: Car shoppers spend an average of 11 hours online researching, according to the article.
facts.quote: A majority of their research is done over the internet, spending an average of 11 hours online and attending virtual events.

facts.fact: Millennials will account for 45% of the vehicle buying cohort, according to a Duff & Phelps source cited in the article.
Since the pandemic, 47% of baby boomers have increased their time spent digitally, per an eMarketer figure cited in the article.
facts.quote: of baby boomers have increased their time spent digitally.
